facts.fact: Vendor states a traditional 30-second video typically costs from a few thousand dollars for a scrappy local shoot to well past six figures for a polished brand film, and takes days to weeks.
facts.value: a few thousand dollars to well past six figures
facts.quote: a traditional 30-second video typically runs anywhere from a few thousand dollars for a scrappy local shoot to well past six figures for a polished brand film

facts.fact: Vendor states an AI-generated 30-second video with Wavemaker costs 75 credits and finishes in two to five minutes.
facts.quote: An AI-generated 30-second video with Wavemaker costs 75 credits

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Free plan costs $0 and includes 75 credits, 480p export, a watermark, and one seat.
facts.quote: Free: $0.** 75 credits to start (enough for your first video), 480p export, watermark, one seat.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Starter plan costs $29 per month and includes 500 credits per month, exports up to 1080p, no watermark, 3 seats, and 5 API keys.
facts.quote: Starter: $29/mo.** 500 credits per month, exports up to 1080p, no watermark, 3 seats, 5 API keys.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Pro plan costs $99 per month, is labeled most popular, and includes 2,000 credits per month with 20% credit rollover.
facts.quote: Pro: $99/mo (most popular).** 2,000 credits per month, API and MCP access, priority generation, custom voice design, 20% credit rollover.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Business plan costs $299 per month and includes 8,000 credits per month, exports up to 4K, 25 seats, webhooks, and 50% credit rollover.
facts.quote: Business: $299/mo.** 8,000 credits per month, exports up to 4K, 25 seats, webhooks, 50% rollover.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's credit packs start at $9.99 per 100 credits, and the packs never expire.
facts.quote: Credit packs:** from $9.99 per 100 credits, and packs never expire.

facts.fact: In Wavemaker's credit schedule, a 60-second video costs 150 credits.
facts.quote: A roughly 30-second video costs 75 credits. A 60-second video costs 150.

facts.fact: In Wavemaker's credit schedule, an edit or refine pass costs 15 credits.
facts.quote: An edit or refine pass is just 15 credits.

facts.fact: In Wavemaker's credit schedule, generating a single image costs 3 credits.
facts.quote: Generating a single image is 3.

facts.fact: In Wavemaker's credit schedule, export costs are 480p free, 720p 5 credits, 1080p 10 credits, and 4K 25 credits.
facts.quote: 480p is free, 720p is 5 credits, 1080p is 10, and 4K is 25.

facts.fact: Vendor states the Starter plan's 500 credits covers roughly six 30-second videos, which it says works out to under $5 per video including a 1080p export.
facts.quote: On Starter at $29 a month, 500 credits covers roughly six 30-second videos, which works out to under $5 per video including a 1080p export.

facts.fact: Vendor states the Pro plan's 2,000 credits covers around 25 to 26 thirty-second videos, roughly $4 each before rollover.
facts.quote: On Pro at $99 a month, 2,000 credits covers around 25 to 26 thirty-second videos, dropping the effective cost to roughly $4 each, and that's before rollover.
